description: PW - ALGORITHMIC EXPANDER — generates the tap times for a Portland Weather placed immediately to its left, replacing its groove patterns with a rhythm built from an algorithm.

params.text: Sets how many steps the pattern is divided into, 1 to 16. Taps beyond that count, and taps on steps with no beat, are muted.
Sets how many beats are placed across the steps, 0 to 16; in Golomb ruler mode it chooses which ruler is used.
Rotates the whole pattern round by up to 15 steps, moving every beat along together.
Holds up to 15 steps at the start of the pattern empty, and packs the beats into the steps that are left.
Steps through three ways of placing beats: yellow is Euclidean, blue is a Golomb ruler, green is a well formed rhythm of long and short steps.
Sets the ratio between the long and short steps of a well formed rhythm, and does nothing in the other two modes.

inputs.text: Adds to the number of steps in the pattern, 1.6 steps per volt.
Adds to the number of beats placed across the steps, 1.5 beats per volt.
Rotates the pattern round, 1.5 steps per volt.
Adds to the number of empty steps at the start of the pattern, 1.5 steps per volt.
A rising edge here steps through the three ways of placing beats.
Adds to the ratio between long and short steps, 10% per volt.

notes: the pattern is timed from the clock and division of the Portland Weather it is attached to, so a clock has to be patched there for the taps to move.
it can be chained after a PW Tap Breakout expander, but not before one.

inputs.4: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
